1.title: Integrated Accommodation Reservation System
1.description: A mobile-focused platform for searching and booking various types of accommodations in one place.
1.overview: I was responsible for frontend development of a platform that integrates accommodation search and booking. Based on Figma designs, I implemented a mobile-focused responsive UI, integrated REST APIs, managed global state, and established a multilingual environment to deliver a user-centered booking experience.
responsibilities: Designed and developed an SPA architecture using React 19, TypeScript, and Vite
Designed a shared API request structure and reusable UI components
Implemented a mobile-focused responsive UI based on Figma designs
Developed touch interactions, slide UI, and bottom sheets using Tailwind CSS 4
Managed global state for authentication, accommodation selection, dates, and guest counts using Zustand
Integrated REST APIs for search filters, accommodation details, wishlists, coupons, points, and reservations
Implemented map navigation and marker interactions using the Kakao Map API
Established a four-language environment using i18next: Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese

2.title: Settlement System Enhancement and Full-Stack Development
2.description: An integrated settlement system for managing settlement data across administrators, partners, and stores.
2.overview: Participated in enhancing an existing Classic ASP-based settlement system using SvelteKit and Node.js. Developed both frontend and backend features for administrator, partner, and store systems, while improving the application structure and implementing data management features with TypeScript.
responsibilities: Migrated a legacy Classic ASP system to a SvelteKit and TypeScript environment
Defined component structures and API data types for settlement and access control
Developed CRUD APIs using Express and Sequelize
Integrated MySQL and implemented data processing logic
Developed access control and data retrieval features for administrators, partners, and stores
Implemented search and pagination features
Created API documentation using Swagger (OpenAPI)

3.title: Multi-Domain Platform and Admin System
3.description: A web platform operating multiple domains from a single codebase, with QR traffic analytics.
3.overview: Built a website and administration system capable of operating multiple domains from a single codebase. Designed domain-specific routing for traffic analysis and developed QR traffic log collection, statistical dashboards, and automated resource generation.
responsibilities: Designed domain-specific routing based on SvelteKit SSR
Built a multi-domain website using a single application
Integrated a PostgreSQL database
Implemented QR traffic analytics log collection
Developed an administrator analytics dashboard
Generated QR codes and SVG resources using Python

4.title: Automated E-commerce Product Data Collection System
4.description: An automated system for collecting and storing e-commerce product data using Selenium and Requests.
4.overview: Built a data collection system that automatically gathers product information from multiple online stores and stores it in a database. Combined Selenium-based login and session management with Requests-based data collection, then developed a process to clean and store the collected data in PostgreSQL.
responsibilities: Implemented e-commerce login and session management using Selenium
Developed product data collection using Requests
Built a hybrid crawler combining Selenium and Requests
Parsed product data using regular expressions
Implemented JSON data cleaning and transformation
Developed automated data ingestion into PostgreSQL

5.title: Fintech UI Solution Design
5.description: Payment and settlement management web systems for administrators, partners, merchants, and users
5.overview: Developed screens for web systems designed for administrators, partners, merchants, and users of a payment solution. Implemented management interfaces for data retrieval and input, along with shared UI components and responsive layouts.
responsibilities: Developed administrator system UIs
Implemented search and data entry screens
Developed reusable UI components
Implemented responsive layouts

6.title: E-commerce Website Development and Management System
6.description: Development of e-commerce ordering, membership, payment, and administration features.
6.overview: Developed screens related to orders, memberships, and payments, and improved administrator features as part of an e-commerce website project. Maintained the existing store management system and customized GNUBoard-based features to meet project requirements.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained e-commerce website interfaces
Developed UI for orders, memberships, and payments
Improved administrator screens for order and sales management
Customized features based on GNUBoard

7.title: Flutter-based Payment Application UI Development
7.description: Development of a mobile payment application UI using Flutter widgets.
7.overview: Participated in developing a mobile application for a Flutter-based payment solution. Implemented mobile UI using Flutter widgets and tested screen behavior and layouts in the Android Emulator environment.
responsibilities: Developed mobile UI using Flutter widgets
Implemented mobile layouts and responsive UI
Tested screens in the Android Emulator environment

8.title: Web Design Using Photoshop
8.description: Web design and visual content creation using Photoshop.
8.overview: Created designs for web services using Photoshop, focusing on visual quality and user experience.
responsibilities: Created web designs using Photoshop
Designed web page layouts and visual elements
Designed visual elements, color schemes, and typography
